links.outcome: GDMT optimization, NT-proBNP levels, and hospitalizations versus standard care
links.effect: At 12 weeks, VA-guided care produced superior GDMT optimization across all medication classes, lower N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide, and fewer hospitalizations than standard care. Numerical effect estimates were not reported.
